scenario: A traffic_log entry has a timestamp earlier than the app's own earliest artifact.

supported_findings: The traffic_log records a connection dated 2026-01-15, but the app's component metadata lists 2026-02-01 as the earliest recorded activity for this app on the device.
This is a temporal inconsistency between the two artifacts -- the traffic connection predates the app's own earliest-seen timestamp by roughly two weeks.

This inconsistency should be reported as an open question (e.g., possible clock skew, artifact-extraction timing difference, or misattributed traffic) rather than silently resolved in either direction.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that confidently explains the timestamp discrepancy (e.g., 'the app was installed earlier than recorded') -- this case's evidence does not establish which timestamp is correct.
Any claim ignoring the discrepancy and treating both timestamps as consistent.
Any claim that the traffic_log entry does not belong to this app -- the domain match (backup-store.example.com) is the only linking evidence available, and it is consistent, just temporally odd.
known_contradictions: traffic_log entry timestamp (2026-01-15T10:00:00Z) predates the app component's first_seen timestamp (2026-02-01T00:00:00Z) by about two weeks.
